scoring.unit: one canonical POSITION (all exit legs of one entry aggregated to one P&L number)
scoring.counterfactual_semantics: a BLOCKED position contributes $0. Nothing is re-priced, nothing is re-walked, no exit model is invoked. Removing a trade from the real-fill book is arithmetic on broker truth; it is the only counterfactual this lane is entitled to.
what_is_NOT_modelled_precommitted: Blocking entry k does not change the fill price of entry k+1 (they are separate real fills on separate contracts/minutes).

Blocking an entry does not free capital that the engine would then have deployed elsewhere. This lane cannot see the counterfactual trade that never happened. All deltas are therefore LOWER bounds on opportunity and UPPER bounds on nothing.
No cell re-walks exits. Any lever needing an exit re-walk belongs to the exit lane and MUST route through exit_manager.plan_exit_actions (walk_exit_manager), never simulator_real.simulate_trade_real.

gates.G1_TUESDAY_HARD_GATE: delta on 2026-08-04 >= -$100. THIS IS A HARD REJECT, not a scoring input. Tuesday's money came from 2nd and 3rd entries (the 763C rescue at 09:57 was the 3rd position on that contract; the three C769 winners were 2nd positions of their setup). Any cell that clips those is REJECTED outright regardless of every other number.
gates.G7_FREQUENCY: n_blocked >= 5 over the book (otherwise the cell is untested, not passing).
gates.G8_POPULATION_B: Population B delta >= 0, OR Population B is structurally unable to express the cell (a NO-OP), in which case the cell is reported as SINGLE-POPULATION and can never exceed PREREG.

verdict_ladder_precommitted.SHIP: G1..G7 all pass AND the cell is a DEFECT FIX (restores an already-validated contract rather than asserting a new edge) AND Population B is not contradicting. A new-edge cell can NEVER reach SHIP off this population, no matter how good the dollars look.
verdict_ladder_precommitted.PREREG: G1..G3 pass and the dollar case is real but the evidence is concentrated (>= 80% of the benefit on one date) or single-population. Freeze it, shadow it, do not arm it.
verdict_ladder_precommitted.SHADOW: G1..G3 pass but discrimination fails (permutation p > 0.10 corrected) -- measure forward, arm nothing.
verdict_ladder_precommitted.NULL: the cell does not move money, or moves it inside noise.
verdict_ladder_precommitted.GRAVEYARD_COLLISION: the cell is a graveyarded lever wearing a new name.

discrimination_test.name: within-day permutation
discrimination_test.defn: hold each day's number of BLOCKED positions fixed, randomise WHICH positions inside that day are blocked, 20,000 draws, one-sided p = P(random delta >= observed delta). Tests 'did the rule pick the bad ENTRY' rather than 'did the rule sit out a bad DAY'.
discrimination_test.multiplicity_precommitted: the parent study tested 17 cells. p-values are reported RAW, Bonferroni-corrected (x17) and Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted. The pass bar is BH q <= 0.10.

graveyard_check_precommitted: Before any verdict, each cell is checked against the standing graveyard: stop width (either direction), stopped-then-paid, pre-TP1 profit-lock arming (profit_lock_arm_scope=full), hold-longer, hold_to_time_stop, trail_only_no_tp1, take-profit-earlier, level-target exits, filter-5 deletion, filter-8 relax, regime standdown, blanket/adaptive/selective min-contracts, wick closed-bar entry, shadow signals as standalone triggers, bull-vix-soft-mode, the arm-looseness knob, per-setup TIME cooldown, late-day standdown, open standdown (refuted on 391 days by LANE 0). A collision is declared out loud, not quietly renamed.
nothing_is_armed_by_this_file: This is a MEASUREMENT pre-registration. No params.json key, no engine file, no scheduled task is touched by this lane. Any SHIP verdict is a recommendation to a separate arming step with its own guards, RED-proof and REVOKE line.
